title: Sparse Interference Graph Recovery from Repeated Exact-Budget Pooled Assignments
banked_reason: Terminal kernel substitution: the delivered recovery-only pool-complexity bracket omits the promised welfare-regret frontier, top-B learning term, and selection-uniform TATE/edge inference.
gap_reasons: kernel_substituted@thm:sharp-pool-complexity-bracket: The delivered object is a recovery-only bracket for m*, whereas the proposal headlined a recovery-valid cumulative-welfare regret frontier with an attaining adaptive design, matching regret converse, and post-selection-uniform martingale inference; none of those headline objects is supplied here.

The all-regime sharp frontier and finite-precision construction remain open; the broader project objective involving cumulative welfare regret, top-B optimization, TATE inference, and selection-uniform edge inference is not defined or proved in the delivered note.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery first attacked the promised degree-one recovery-regret frontier, but its balanced-pool construction and information-to-welfare obligations did not close. A later angle produced sound recovery-only identification, concentration, certificate, and pool-complexity bracket results, yet substituted A and m* for the promised R*, omitted top-B welfare regret and selection-uniform TATE/edge inference, and left the recovery frontier itself open. Independent validity review found that restoring the original kernel would require several new theorem programs rather than a scoped repair, so the original topic terminated while these recovery artifacts remain reusable for a separately named salvage.
tldr: Repeated exact-budget assignments turn unknown additive interference into \(n\) sparse regressions sharing one constrained design. The paper proves noiseless exact identification through a structured sparse singular value, uniform excitation by random fixed-cardinality pools, and exact support recovery under beta-min separation and rowwise conditionally sub-Gaussian noise. For exact mathematical optimizer outputs, the Dantzig construction also gives simultaneous edge and nonedge decisions, while partially penalized Lasso gives a second exact-support upper bound. An adaptive information converse yields a two-sided minimax pool-count bracket and matches the upper bound up to universal constants when \(\sigma^2/\delta^2\ge s+1\). The all-regime sharp frontier, the low-noise sparse-exploration converse, and a certified polynomial-time finite-precision procedure for producing the optimizer outputs remain open.
gap: Unknown-network causal papers either bypass graph recovery or learn neighborhoods while optimizing regret, passive wireless graph-recovery papers observe CSMA/CA activations and ACK/NACK events, and sparse-recovery papers use Gaussian, independently sparsified, or Boolean observation schemes; none obeys a designed treatment-total constraint with signed full-vector responses.
fill: The project supplies an exact injectivity criterion, a constant-row-weight restricted-excitation theorem, a polynomial-real-arithmetic certificate-producing decoder with an explicit numerical buffer, and adaptive information lower bounds over fully measurable design-decoder pairs on the same directed signed model.
